messages:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly Saffron account health check — need token + throughput snapshot. Pls drop last 7d numbers with WoW and QoQ trends. Notable: latency spike Wed ~17:20 and a small uptick in 5xxs. cc @Jordan @Ravi @Elena

Jordan (CS Ops): Last 7d tokens: 1,245,600 (+18% WoW). QoQ tokens: +58%. Throughput avg: 46 req/s (p95 320ms) WoW +20%. Spend last7d: $4.2k (+12% WoW). /chat accounts for ~68% of tokens. CSV uploaded.

Jordan (CS Ops): Query I ran (for reference):
```
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM metrics
WHERE account = 'saffron' AND date >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
```

Ravi (Infra SE): Saw the Wed 17:18 spike — root cause was a model-shard OOM on the dedicated pool, auto-failover triggered which caused a short burst of 5xxs. Weekly error rate: 0.40% (vs 0.12% last week). Increased KV-cache priming and bumped replicas as mitigation, alert added.

Elena (PM): Onboarding update: new marketing cohort (~50 users) started Tue, many using streaming endpoints -> tokens/session up ~40%. This lines up with the token ramp. Renewal risk: low but needs enablement on batching/KV caching to control spend. I can run a 30min enablement Thurs 11am PT.

Maya (CS): Action items:
- @Ravi: confirm fix persisted + RCA by EOD
- @Jordan: share per-route spend and a few sample sessions
- @Elena: schedule the enablement + 1-pager best-practices
I'll ping the account owner for a renewal check. :calendar: :thumbsup:

redwood-telemetry-bot: Automated snapshot uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/artifacts/saffron-weekly-1776509999.csv

Jordan (CS Ops): Shared the CSV in the thread. Quick calc: enabling auto-batching on their dedicated pool could reduce token spend ~18-22% for their current mix.

Ravi (Infra SE): RCA posted in ops-docs: new quantized model variant caused transient OOM, reverted to previous variant, replicas stabilized. 5xxs back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS): Perfect, thanks team — I'll handle the renewal touch and follow up after the enablement. Will update this thread next Tue unless anything else pops up.
